body:
I have had a decent amount of experience with 5-Meo DALT in the past, including one heroic dose where about 200mgs were ingested orally.
T 0:00: Measurement conducted through a colloidal suspension of the powder (as it does not dissolve) in a very precise amount of water. Liquid then measured in a shot glass/measuring cup with an accuracy of 2-3mL.
T 0:10: Slight feeling of an altered state, but tough to exactly pin down a feeling. Not jittery or euphoric really. If I had to describe it I would say it felt like my mind was entering a light fog
T 0:25: Mild visual distortions, hands seem to be large and awkward, depth perception is affected most strongly, with a rising feeling of euphoria. The fog from before is gone, and though I anticipate a change in reaction speed I have yet to notice one. Testing fine motor skills by attempting to roll a joint.
T 0:45: Continued distortions, successful joint rolling, though it took much longer than normal. I find that my actions are generally slower and more meticulous, and that obsessive compulsive tendencies are increased, though not to levels high enough to be considered true OCD. Tracers not noted, though a general feeling of disorientation is noted. The disorientation is pleasant, and a very common effect that I feel from psychedelics. High level of fascination in the mundane.
T 0:55: approx. 20mg MDPV insufflated. Measurement was crude, mostly through eyeballing my own standard dose, but it was certainly not over 20mg.
T 1:05: as the MDPV is kicking in I am smoking a high grade cannabis joint, containing about half a gram in tobacco rolling papers (no, not blunt wraps, paper made of tobacco.
) A huge wave of euphoria is spreading through me and the world is becoming largely surreal. Visuals not really patterns, but shades seem to change  and shapes definitely distort. My hands dont feel awkward any more, but they do feel very far away, and they have to twist to stay on the keyboard. The fact that I am able to type is astounding to me, but Im making very few mistakes, and am typing at a normal pace. I have a definite sensation of soaring, and feel as if my mind is leaving my body. The entire sensation is incredibly pleasant, and tactile sensations feel increasingly pleasurable, though I would not describe myself as aroused. Sex seems more to be a passing fancy, and while the increased pleasure is very pronounced, everything else in life is just so fascinating. All thoughts and sensations are starting to give me intense love for things around me. The Itunes equalizer is incredibly intuitive to me, and each different sound range is incredibly pronounced. I am easily able to create the perfect mix of sound.
It is fast becoming very difficult for me to describe how incredible this feeling is, and over the 15 minutes I have written this I believe I have truly taken off. The amount I am writing and the fluidity of it all probably says something about this trip. Im going to enjoy my Itunes visualizer for a while and write any important new details, but Im going to just sink in and enjoy this trip.
T 1:20 Turned off lamplight, Visuals increase DRAMATICALLY in total darkness.
T 1:45 cold is bad for this trip, makes it hard to lose myself in feelings. Closed nearby window. Astounded at the amount of technology that went into making something cool for me to watch while I trip.
T 2:00 jaw tensing quite a bit, eating is difficult, but well worth the effort. Urge to start mild flirting with women online.
T 2:05 Trip is definitely peaking. Time is extremely drawn out. I am saying 5 minutes has passed mostly to preserve my dignity. Its actually more like 2-3 minutes. Tactile sensations too incredible to ignore.
T 3:00 Trip is on its way down, but over by no means. Ive left the time warp.
T 4:30 Nearing baseline, trying to get some sleep, and found that sleep came fairly easily.
